matches.snippet: that may be excessive. School Costs Most of our financial trouble can be attributed to the increasing costs ofthe public schools. Some of this increase has resulted from recent changes in  Day 2 SENATE JOURNAL 33 school financing laws, and the remainder from the enrollment of the huge post­war baby crop. Inasmuch as further enrollment increases are expected for the next decade and possibly longer, the school financing problem will be a perennial headache. Last biennium, we appropriated over $13 million from the Emergency Relief fund for the support of the schools. This enabled us to forego the im­position of a State property tax, but at the same time it so depleted our State funds that little or nothing was left for a building program.
